cases.reviewed: Puppies & Pinot: Santa Paws Edition (11 AM-3 PM)

cases.refreshed: In this program kids in grades 3-6 will learn how to draw and create on iPads using the Sketchbook app. Students will learn about sketch lines which they will be able to use in their fun and engaging Emoji art projects! Everything needed for this course will be provided, but you are more than welcome to bring your own personal iPad with the free Sketchbook app downloaded, especially if you want to save your work. Free. Registration is recommended. This series is taught in English only. Registration closes at 12 PM the day before class. However, if seats are still available, students in grades 3-6 can walk in on Saturday if they arrive before 3 PM to sign in. Maximum class size is 25. Although the class is scheduled from 3-4:30 PM, students who finish their projects early are welcome to leave early. Todos Pueden Crear: Arte de Emojis Sábado, 7 de noviembre de 2026 | 3:00–4:30 p.m. Niños y niñas de 3.º a 6.º grado explorarán el arte digital utilizando iPads y la aplicación Sketchbook. Los participantes aprenderán los conceptos básicos del dibujo, comenzando con líneas de boceto y formas, y aplicarán estas habilidades para diseñar divertidas y expresivas obras de arte con emojis. Todo lo necesario para este curso será proporcionado, pero puedes traer tu propio iPad personal con la aplicación gratuita Sketchbook descargada, especialmente si deseas guardar tu trabajo. Gratis. Se recomienda registrarse con anticipación. Esta serie será enseñada únicamente en inglés. La inscripción cierra a las 12 p.m. el día antes de la clase. Si quedan espacios disponibles, los alumnos de grado 3 a 6 pueden venir el sábado e inscribirse antes de las 15:00 p.m. La clase tiene un cupo máximo de 25 alumnos. Aunque la clase está programada de 3-4:30 p.m., los alumnos que terminan sus proyectos antes podrán retirarse si lo desean. Mọi Người Đều Có Thể Sáng Tạo: Nghệ Thuật Biểu Tượng Cảm Xúc Thứ Bảy, ngày 7 tháng 11 năm 2026 3:00 chiều – 4:30 chiều Trong chương trình này, các em học sinh từ lớp 3 đến lớp 6 sẽ học cách vẽ và sáng tạo trên iPad bằng ứng dụng Sketchbook. Các em học sinh sẽ được học về các đường nét phác thảo, sau đó áp dụng vào các dự án nghệ thuật biểu tượng cảm xúc thú vị và hấp dẫn của mình. Mọi thứ cần thiết cho khóa học này sẽ được cung cấp, nhưng bạn hoàn toàn có thể mang theo iPad cá nhân của mình với ứng dụng Sketchbook miễn phí đã tải xuống, đặc biệt khi bạn muốn lưu tác phẩm của mình. Miễn phí. Xin vui lòng ghi danh trước. Lớp học được chỉ dạy hoàn toàn bằng tiếng anh. Thời hạn ghi danh kết thúc vào 12 giờ trưa ngày trước khi lớp học bắt đầu. Tuy nhiên, nếu vẫn còn chỗ trống, học sinh lớp 3-6 có thể đến trực tiếp vào thứ Bảy nếu đến trước 3 giờ chiều để điểm danh. Lớp học tối đa là 25 học sinh. Mặc dù lớp học được lên lịch từ 3 đến 4 giờ 30 chiều, nhưng học sinh nào hoàn thành bài tập sớm có thể về sớm.

cases.refreshed: Join us as Evergreen Branch celebrates 20 years of serving the community! Opening Remarks: Ash Kalra, Assemblymember, California State Assembly District 25; Matt Mahan, Mayor, City of San José; Domingo Candelas, District 8 Councilmember, City of San José; Jill Bourne, City Librarian, San José Public Library. Live Entertainment and Activities: Cultural dance performance by Jayendra Kalakendra; Cultural dance performance by Ensamble Folclórico Colibrí; Balloon art giveaway; Face painting; Giant bubble play stations; Grab-and-go craft kits*; Prize wheel*; Prize drawing*; Refreshments*. *While supplies last Share Your Story Share your Evergreen Branch story and help us celebrate 20 years by telling us about a favorite memory, experience, or special moment. Did you know? Evergreen Branch is home to Discoveries, a public artwork by Larry Kirkland featuring three white marble sculptures of an ear, mouth, and eye that celebrate learning and discovery through our senses. Stop by and check it out during your next visit. Special Thanks This event has been generously sponsored by the San José Public Library Foundation, Friends of the Evergreen Branch Library, and Friends of the West Valley Branch Library.

cases.refreshed: Do you need help using a computer? Want to set up an email account? Stop by the Vineland Branch Library for a 30-minute session with our experienced volunteer! They can assist you with basic tech issues, such as: Setting up an email account, composing & sending emails, using email attachments; Web searches and basic data entry; Learning the basics of Microsoft Word and Excel and web-based productivity software such as Google Docs; Using the library's pay-for-print and photocopy machines; Using social networking services like Facebook; Downloading apps on your phone or tablet; And much more! You are welcome to bring your own device, such as a laptop, phone or tablet, or you can use one of our computers. Registration required. To make an appointment, stop by the Vineland Library or call us at 408-808-3000.

events.title: Everyone Can Create: Autumn Drawing with Sketchbook

cases.refreshed: Bring your imagination to life with autumn-inspired digital art. We will explore creative tools and techniques using the popular Sketchbook app. iPads are provided for class use. If you'd like to save your project, please feel free to bring your personal iPad or Android tablet (please install the free Sketchbook app prior to the workshop). This introductory class is recommended for ages 7–14 (Older siblings welcome) Free. Registration is recommended. Drop-ins are welcome.

events.title: Volunteer Away Your Fines as a Drop-in Do Gooder

cases.refreshed: Drop-in the first Saturday of the month to volunteer away your library fines at a rate of $20 per hour while helping the library maintain a clean and welcoming environment. Details and Requirements: • Must be able to commit to the full session • Anyone under the age of 15 must volunteer alongside a parent/guardian • No experience or special skills necessary To register, please call 408-808-3075 or email sarah.kishler@sjlibrary.org

events.title: Everyone Can Code: Rock, Paper, Scissors Using Swift Playgrounds

cases.refreshed: Create your own rock, paper, scissors game using Swift Playground! Everyone Can Code is a beginner's course on using iPads to code and modify technology, such as online games. Students will be learning the basics of coding and implementing them through the modification of rock, paper, scissors. Everything needed for this course will be provided, but you are more than welcome to bring your own personal iPad with the free Swift Playgrounds app downloaded, especially if you want to save your work. Free. Registration is recommended. This series is taught in English only. Registration closes at 12 PM the day before class. However, if seats are still available, students in grades 3-6 can walk in on Saturday if they arrive before 3 PM to sign in. Maximum class size is 25. Although the class is scheduled from 3-4:30 PM, students who finish their projects early are welcome to leave early. Todos pueden programar: Piedra, papel o tijera con Swift Playgrounds: ¡Crea tu propio juego de piedra, papel o tijera usando Swift Playgrounds! Sábado 31 de octubre de 2026 de 3 a 4:30 horas. 'Todos pueden programar' es un curso para principiantes que enseña a utilizar iPads para programar y modificar tecnología, como los juegos en línea. Los estudiantes aprenderán los conceptos básicos de la programación y los pondrán en práctica modificando el juego de piedra, papel o tijera. Todo lo necesario para este curso será proporcionado, pero puedes traer tu propio iPad personal con la aplicación gratuita Swift Playgrounds descargada, especialmente si deseas guardar tu trabajo. Gratis. Se recomienda registrarse con anticipación. Esta serie será enseñada únicamente en inglés. La inscripción cierra a las 12 p.m. el día antes de la clase. Everyone Can Code: Trò Chơi Kéo-Búa-Bao với Swift Playgrounds Thứ Bảy, ngày 31 tháng 10 năm 2026 từ 3-4:30 giờ chiều Hãy tự tạo trò chơi Kéo-Búa-Bao cho riêng quý vị bằng Swift Playgrounds! "Everyone Can Code" là khóa học dành cho người mới bắt đầu, hướng dẫn cách sử dụng iPad để lập trình và sửa đổi kỹ thuật công nghệ, chẳng hạn như trò chơi trực tuyến.
